Title: Lookup case, trailing space, NULL and duplicate-key semantics
Notes: SSIS full-cache Lookup compares bytes: 'p-100' and 'P-100 ' do not match 'P-100', and 'P-300' does not match the reference 'P-300 '. The first duplicate reference row wins (P-200 -> Parts, reference query ORDER BY RefId). A NULL input matches the NULL reference key in full cache mode (InputId 4 -> Unknown; observed on SSIS 2025). A SQL join under a CI collation matches the case and trailing-space variants, never matches NULL and returns both P-200 rows.

Title: Blank vs NULL from a flat file
Notes: Input tests/parity/data/G23_blanks.csv. SSIS RetainNulls=False loads an empty or quoted-empty string as '', a space-only value as ' ' and an empty integer as 0; an empty DT_DBDATE field fails the destination ('Invalid date format'), so P23 reads ShipDate as text and maps blank to NULL. ADF delimited text turns empty into NULL unless nullValue is changed.

Title: Code page, Unicode, truncation and numeric rounding
Notes: Inputs G24_types_1252.csv (code page 1252, CRLF) and G24_types_utf8.csv (UTF-8 BOM, LF, no final newline). SSIS (observed on 2025): 'Longer than ten' is cut to 'Longer tha' (truncation ignored); DT_NUMERIC(9,2) truncates, it does not round (12.345 -> 12.34, 7.005 -> 7.00, -0.005 -> 0.00); text outside 1252 is best-fit mapped in varchar (Polish L-stroke -> L, CJK -> '?').

Title: Which duplicate survives
Notes: C002 and C003 tie on UpdatedAt. P25 feeds Sort (remove duplicates, key CustomerKey) rows ordered CustomerKey, UpdatedAt DESC, RowId; SSIS 2025 kept the last row of each key in that order in every run (C001 -> the older row, C002 -> RowId 4, C003 -> RowId 6). Microsoft documents the survivor as arbitrary, so the rewrite states the rule explicitly and this case fails if a future SSIS build changes it.

Title: Fast-load options: constraints, defaults, nulls
Notes: P26 uses CHECK_CONSTRAINTS and FIRE_TRIGGERS, KeepNulls off, commit size 1 and an error output, so only the bad row is rejected. Amount 0.00 violates CK Amount > 0: rejected with CHECK_CONSTRAINTS, loaded (constraint left untrusted) without. NULL Channel stays NULL with KEEPNULLS, becomes 'unknown' without. LoadId depends on insert order, so it is ignored.

Title: Fast-load FIRE_TRIGGERS
Notes: Audit rows exist only when the bulk load fires triggers. Runs after G26-LOADOPT in the same package/pipeline run.

Title: System variables and date-folder expressions
Notes: RunDate 2026-01-31 must give ArchiveFolder archive\2026\01\, MonthFolder 2026-01 and FileStamp 20260131 on both sides. Machine, user, start time and execution GUID change meaning on an IR or SHIR, so they are recorded but not compared.

Title: Output file names, split points, headers and final newline
Notes: One file per Region plus files split every 10 rows, named with a date-time stamp. The stamp is masked before names are compared; content, line count, header, final newline and encoding are compared per file.

Title: Single-row result set with no rows
Notes: pty.G30_Driver is empty. SSIS fails the Execute SQL Task (single row expected, no rows returned). The ADF rewrite must also fail, and fail at the same step, rather than continue with no firstRow.
